footer.disclaimer: Live data from the KhetiSetu API. Rows the API reports as synthetic backfill, and guidance it reports as unverified, are labelled where they appear. home.intro: KhetiSetu combines historical crop demand, weather and agricultural season rules to help farmers identify crops with stronger future demand opportunities.
home.note: Decision support, not a profit guarantee. Every number in this prototype is synthetic demo data.
home.heroAlt: Indian farmer checking crop information on a mobile phone in a tomato and onion field

benefits.subheading: Not just "how do I grow this crop", but "will there likely be demand when my crop is ready?"

pipeline.heading: From demand gap to crop opportunity
pipeline.body: KhetiSetu brings farmer context, historical demand, expected supply, weather and crop season rules together — then explains the recommendation instead of pretending to predict the future perfectly.

meta.title: Weather what-if scenario | KhetiSetu
meta.description: Move the rainfall slider and see how crop opportunity scores and the safest recommendation change.
meta.ogDescription: Simulate rainfall changes on crop suitability.

whatif.emptyDetail: The scenario runs against the crops KhetiSetu ranked for your district, so it needs a recommendation to work from.
whatif.title: What if the weather changes?
whatif.subtitle: Adjust expected rainfall for {{district}} and see how crop opportunity scores respond.
whatif.changedDetail: Under a {{delta}}% rainfall change, {{crop}} scores highest — a different crop than the baseline ranking.
whatif.unchangedDetail: {{crop}} still leads under a {{delta}}% rainfall change.
whatif.disclaimer: The scenario rescales recorded rainfall for your district and re-scores weather suitability. It does not model soil, variety or field management, which also change how a crop responds to rainfall.

ask.title: Ask KhetiSetu
ask.subtitle: Ask about your crop recommendation. Answers are grounded in indexed sources only.
ask.tokenNoticeTitle: This endpoint needs an API token
ask.tokenNoticeDetail: The API requires a bearer token on /rag/query. Set VITE_API_TOKEN in this app's .env and restart the dev server. Sending a question below will show the API's reply either way.
ask.intro: Namaste! I answer from sources indexed in the KhetiSetu knowledge base and the recorded data for your district — so if I don't have grounded information for something, I'll say so rather than guess.
ask.unreachable: The knowledge base could not be reached.

suggestions.whyFirst: Why is this crop ranked first?
suggestions.lowerRainfall: What happens if rainfall is lower?
suggestions.fertilizer: What fertilizer does this crop need?
suggestions.demandGap: How is the demand gap calculated?

ask.disclaimer: Answers come from the API's retrieval layer over indexed source documents. No language model is involved, and the assistant declines rather than answering from an unindexed topic.

howItWorks.title: How KhetiSetu works
howItWorks.subtitle: Five steps that connect what you can grow with what the market may need.
howItWorks.coreIdeaBody: Farmers need to understand not only what they can grow, but whether there may be demand when the crop is ready. KhetiSetu turns the gap between expected demand and expected supply into a clear crop opportunity — and explains how it got there.

reliability.title: AI Reliability & Responsible AI
reliability.subtitle: Why the recommendations can be trusted — and where their limits are.

evaluation.title: Forecast evaluation
evaluation.description: Demand forecast error compared against a seasonal-average baseline.
evaluation.disclaimer: These are demo evaluation values from a prototype dataset. They are not production-validated results.

confidence.title: Confidence levels
confidence.description: What high, medium and low confidence mean.

high.body: Several seasons of consistent data and stable weather.

medium.body: Partial data coverage or moderate weather variation.

low.body: Limited history or unusual conditions — treat with caution.

confidence.note: Confidence decreases when historical data is limited or weather conditions are unusual.

checklist.title: Responsible AI checklist
checklist.dataProtected: Farmer data protected and never shown individually

edgeCases.title: Edge cases
edgeCases.description: What happens when the data is not good enough.

noHistory.title: No historical data
noHistory.body: Confidence drops and the crop is shown as low-evidence.

noWeather.title: Weather unavailable
noWeather.body: Weather suitability is withheld instead of estimated.

extremeRain.title: Extreme rainfall
extremeRain.body: Scenario warning is shown and risk is raised.

newDistrict.title: New district
newDistrict.body: Nearby district patterns are used, clearly labeled as such.

noSource.title: No reliable source
noSource.body: The system declines to answer rather than guessing.

edgeCases.note: In all of these cases, KhetiSetu reduces confidence or asks for more information instead of guessing.
